title: Why Computers Need Electricity
summary: Computers need steady power, and data centers plan for interruptions.
objectives: Describe why reliable power and backup systems matter without performing electrical work.

vocab.def: Energy that can power devices and systems.
A system that can provide power when the usual source is interrupted.

sections.heading: Power makes computing possible
sections.body: Servers, switches, lights, cooling equipment, and safety systems all need power. Without enough power, computers cannot keep processing and communicating.

sections.heading: Reliability is planned
sections.body: Data centers plan for interruptions. Backup systems can help important equipment keep operating while a power problem is addressed. Planning does not make every interruption harmless.

sections.heading: Safe classroom learning
sections.body: We can study a power path with diagrams and cards. Professional electrical work requires qualified supervision and is not a classroom task.

practice.prompt: Put these ideas in order on a diagram: power source, facility systems, server, digital response.

quiz.question: Why do data centers plan for backup power?
options: To help systems continue during an interruption
To make servers use no energy
quiz.answer: To help systems continue during an interruption

reflectionPrompt: What question would you ask about the energy used by a digital service?
